Name: Qi's Fading Elevator
Author: tteokl
Description:
Qi's Fading Elevator puts a broken lift beside the Skull Cavern entrance. Bring five iridium bars and a battery pack to repair it. From then on, the old shaft remembers the deepest floor you've reached and lets you return there in steps.

The cavern slowly erases that memory. It fades every in-game hour, even while you sleep. Damage taken while inside Skull Cavern also knocks it back immediately, including monster attacks, explosions, and other health loss; harder hits cost more floors. Don't worry—it will remember the way again once you find a ladder or shaft and advance to a deeper floor.

A small gauge appears only inside Skull Cavern. It shows how much of your deepest run the elevator still remembers. The lift and gauge adjust their colors and placement to suit the entrance and the different cavern themes.

Qi's Fading Elevator is free and open source. If you enjoy it, optional support is available through [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/tteokl/shop]tteokl[/url].
